scope: Actual positive mixed Gamma mass and original pair-plane coarea support; final ordered/base averaged bounds are separate

passages.claim: The actual first positive facet densities for the mass and original pair-plane quadratic tests are measurable, globally bounded and Lipschitz in the second coordinate. Ordinary volume-a.e. local hard mixed derivatives pull through actual Gamma threshold absolute continuity, giving exact sigma^-1 Gamma averages of the actual native pair kernels.

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.hasDerivAt_gamma_positiveMass_offset
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)),
  (∀ (k : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u k) = 1) →
    ∀ (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m) {h σ : ℝ},
      0 < h →
        0 < σ →
          ∀ (x : RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (j l : Fin m),
            j ≠ l →
              RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u j) + RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u l) ≠ 0 →
                RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u j) - RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u l) ≠ 0 →
                  ∀ (q : ℕ),
                    HasDerivAt
                      (fun t =>
                        ∫ (e : ℝ × (RectangleCLT.Face m → ℝ)),
                          RectangleCLTArxivV1.positiveMixedFirstMassDensity u
                            (fun k =>
                              (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gammaAdjustedThreshold (Function.update a l (a l + t)) h e
                                    k -
                                  RectangleCLT.faceDot (u k) x) /
                                σ)
                            j ∂RectangleCLT.Companion.gammaRectangleLaw m q)
                      (σ⁻¹ *
                        ∫ (e : ℝ × (RectangleCLT.Face m → ℝ)),
                          RectangleCLTArxivV1.positiveGammaMixedMassKernel u
                            (fun k =>
                              (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gammaAdjustedThreshold a h e k -
                                  RectangleCLT.faceDot (u k) x) /
                                σ)
                            j l ∂RectangleCLT.Companion.gammaRectangleLaw m q)
                      0

passages.qualification: The actual pair kernel uses Gaussian measure on the Euclidean orthonormal pair section. q indexes positive Gamma shapeq+1. The plane kernel is mass times the squared conditional normal length, proved equal to the original pair-plane projection norm on the ridge. The final Gamma identities require no slack or full-family independence premise; ordered summation and concentrated-base bounds are separate.

passages.claim: The exact second original-threshold derivative of F^(q+1) times its first face factor gives(q+1)(q+2)/h^2 times the actual positive mass or original pair-plane quadratic soft integral. The true Gamma expectation of the actual native pair-section kernel occurs with exactly sigma^-2; only the selected pair is nonparallel.

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.positiveMass_soft_mixed_coarea
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)),
  (∀ (k : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u k) = 1) →
    ∀ (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m) {h σ : ℝ},
      0 < h →
        0 < σ →
          ∀ (x : RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (j l : Fin m),
            j ≠ l →
              RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u j) + RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u l) ≠ 0 →
                RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u j) - RectangleCLT.projectionEuclideanVector (u l) ≠ 0 →
                  ∀ (q : ℕ),
                    (↑q + 1) / h * ((↑q + 2) / h) *
                        ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)),
                          RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight u a h (x + σ • g) ^ (q + 1) *
                              RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticFaceWeight u a h (x + σ • g) j *
                            RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticFaceWeight u a h (x + σ • g)
                              l ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian (n + 1) =
                      σ⁻¹ *
                        (σ⁻¹ *
                          ∫ (e : ℝ × (RectangleCLT.Face m → ℝ)),
                            RectangleCLTArxivV1.positiveGammaMixedMassKernel u
                              (fun k =>
                                (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gammaAdjustedThreshold a h e k -
                                    RectangleCLT.faceDot (u k) x) /
                                  σ)
                              j l ∂RectangleCLT.Companion.gammaRectangleLaw m q)
